description: A Boolean filter is an ultrafilter exactly when its element-complement dual ideal is maximal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.ultrafilter_dual_maximal.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (F : Order.PFilter B)
  (I : Order.Ideal B) (hI : ↑I = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.dualIdeal F) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsUltrafilter F ↔ I.IsMaximal
